description: This file is a test script for Git, checking the behavior of 'git read-tree' with confusing or problematic filesystem paths under various 'core.protectHFS' and 'core.protectNTFS' configurations. It sets up test repositories, configures Git settings, and runs multiple test cases to verify how 'read-tree' handles path conflicts, special characters, and case-insensitivity on filesystems that mimic HFS or NTFS behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing commands within its body.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to be run after tests.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets a Git configuration for the test environment.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the following command fails.

methods.name: ok
methods.description: Checks or confirms the success of a previous operation.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
